scope: platform account journeys only; domain journeys are added with features

preconditions: loopback API and web server running
journeys.goal: Sign in to the local app
mainPath: read the current account from the server
journeys.loading: announce pending sign-in; disable duplicate submission
journeys.empty: signed-out form is distinct from failed loading
journeys.failed: retain input and focus the error
journeys.denied: show the server refusal without claiming sign-in
journeys.recovery: correct input or retry the request
journeys.success: account heading and details only after a fresh session read

preconditions: loopback API and web server running
journeys.goal: Read the current account and retain the session across reload
validation: malformed session data is not success
journeys.failed: show a separate retryable loading failure

preconditions: loopback API and web server running
mainPath: confirm absence through a fresh read
validation: an already-expired session still requires absence confirmation
journeys.loading: announce pending sign-out; disable duplicate submission
journeys.failed: retain the account with an error until the outcome is confirmed
journeys.denied: 401 is followed by an independent session read
journeys.conflict: a remaining session prevents a success claim
journeys.success: sign-in heading focused and session cookie removed
